title: Window Library
subtitle: Every panel and window of Orkestr: pick one and open it where you need it
emptyHint: Try another word in English or Russian, or clear the filters
openNowTitle: This window is open right now

toast.layoutLocked: The layout is locked: unlock it to add panels

manager.summary: Talk to the AI Manager: describe a goal, get a plan, approve it and watch the agents run it.
manager.details: The main entry point of Orkestr. The AI Manager turns your request into a plan of tasks, asks for approval in the selected approval mode, starts agents and reports progress, costs and results right in the chat.

code.summary: Monaco editor with tabs, diffs, project search and quick open.
code.details: A fast native code editor for the active project: multiple tabs, syntax highlighting, inline diffs of agent changes, Ctrl+P quick open, Ctrl+Shift+F project search and Save / Save all.

files.summary: Project file tree with create, rename, move and delete.
files.details: Browse the project folder, open files in the editor, create files and folders, rename, drag to move and delete with confirmation. Shows changed files and respects the project ignore rules.

terminal.summary: Real PTY terminals in the project folder, several sessions at once.
terminal.details: Full terminal sessions (PowerShell, cmd, bash) running in the project folder. Open several tabs, split them, and see the commands agents run. Ctrl+` toggles the terminal.

git.summary: Status, changes, commits, branches, worktrees and snapshots.
git.details: Everything about version control: staged and unstaged changes with diffs, commit, branches and worktrees used by agents, history, and snapshots you can roll back to.

agents.summary: Agent templates and running agents: start, pause and inspect them.
agents.details: See every agent of the project with its state, model and current task. Create agents from templates, adjust their tools and limits, pause, resume or stop them.

tasks.summary: Task board and dependency graph of the current work.
tasks.details: A kanban board and a DAG view of all tasks: statuses, assignees, dependencies and review results. Create tasks by hand or let the AI Manager plan them.

architecture.summary: Map of the project architecture and its decision log.
architecture.details: An interactive map of modules and dependencies built from the code, plus the architecture decision log, so agents and people share the same picture of the system.

browser.summary: Browser agent that clicks through web apps for you.
browser.details: A visual browser driven by an agent: opens pages, fills forms and checks the UI of your app. Not available yet: it arrives in a later phase.

database.summary: Explore database schemas and run queries.
database.details: Connect to the project databases, browse tables and schemas and run queries with results in a grid. Not available yet: it arrives in a later phase.

logs.summary: Live stream of every event in the core, with filters.
logs.details: The event journal of Orkestr in real time: agent steps, tool calls, approvals, errors and system messages. Filter by level, source and text, and pause the stream.

deployments.summary: Environments, deployment pipelines and their history.
deployments.details: Configure environments, deploy with approval, follow pipeline steps live, and roll back a failed release. Secrets stay in the vault.

memory.summary: Project memory and knowledge base the agents learn from.
memory.details: Facts, decisions, conventions and documents the agents remember about the project. Search, edit and pin entries so every agent follows the same rules.

costs.summary: Token usage and spending, budgets and limits per provider.
costs.details: How much each provider, model, agent and task costs, with daily and monthly charts. Set budgets and limits so the AI stops before it overspends.

missionControl.summary: One-screen overview of agents, runs, spend and alerts.
missionControl.details: The operations dashboard of all projects: active agents and runs, pending approvals, spending, alerts and quick actions, laid out as a configurable wall of widgets.

monitoring.summary: CPU, memory, GPU and processes of this computer and the core.
monitoring.details: Live resource charts of the node, heavy processes, core health checks and alert rules, so you see at once when something slows the work down.

vscode.summary: Full VS Code (VSCodium) on the project folder, with Open VSX extensions.
vscode.details: A complete VS Code workbench running inside Orkestr: its own editor, debugger, extensions from Open VSX and settings, opened on the active project folder.

extensions.summary: Install VS Code extensions: themes, icons, grammars, language servers.
extensions.details: Search Open VSX and install extensions for the native editor and VS Code: color themes, icon packs, language grammars and language servers, with updates and removal.

claudeCode.summary: Chat with Claude Code (the official CLI) about the project.
claudeCode.details: Run the official Claude Code CLI on your subscription inside Orkestr: chat, see tool calls and file edits as they happen, and answer permission requests right in the chat.

nodes.summary: Connected computers, remote jobs and model distribution.
nodes.details: Enroll other computers as nodes, run jobs on them, see their resources and spread local models between them to share the load.

marketplace.summary: Plugins, widgets and agent templates from signed registries.
marketplace.details: Browse, install and manage signed plugins, dashboard widgets and agent templates. Review the permissions a plugin asks for, and publish your own packages.

dashboards.summary: Build your own dashboards from built-in and plugin widgets.
dashboards.details: Compose dashboards from widgets: agents, costs, tasks, monitoring charts and plugin widgets. Arrange them on a grid and switch between several dashboards.

bugDetective.summary: Investigate incidents: evidence, root cause and approved fixes.
bugDetective.details: Collects logs, traces and recent changes around a failure, explains the most likely root cause and proposes a fix that is applied only after your approval.

settings.title: Settings
settings.summary: Language, providers, voice, security, performance and every other option.
settings.details: All settings of Orkestr in one place: general, appearance, AI providers and API keys, voice, security and approvals, performance mode, updates and more.

themeEditor.title: Theme Editor
themeEditor.summary: Design your own theme with a live preview and contrast check.
themeEditor.details: Change colors, background, blur, glow and spacing of the interface with a live preview of the whole app and an automatic WCAG contrast check.

layoutEditor.title: Layout Editor
layoutEditor.details: Choose which panels each layout shows, assign them to monitors or separate windows, and save, rename, export or import layouts.
